text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, Dec 16 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 3 vessels due by 23/12, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 14 due by 29/12, approx. 1 days delay.
Hay Point - No.1 berth will be closed until 0900 hours 23/12 for maintenance. One vessel loading, 4 waiting, 11 due by 30/12, approx. 2-3 days delay.
Gladstone - AMU members at the Gladstone port authority returned to work at 0700 hours 12/12.
R.G. Tanna - 1 Vessel loading, 3 waiting, 19 due by 20/1/97, approx. 2-3 days delay.
Barney Point - Berth vacant. 7 Vessels due by 24/1/97, no delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant. 3 Vessels due by 1/1/97, no delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Industrial dispute, the threatened national strike over retrenchments at Metropolitan Mine has been averted. The NSW government has agreed to a rescue package.
Newcastle - Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 5 waiting, 21 due by 2/1/97, approx. 5-6 days delay.
Channel dyke - 2 Vessels loading, 4 waiting, 20 due by 2/1/97, approx. 6-7 days delay.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 19 due by 5/2/97/ approx. 1-2 days delay.
IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Shippers advise that loading will stop at both Nelson Point and Finucane Island berths from 2359 hours 24/12 until 2359 hours 26/12.

Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Berth A - 1 Vessel loading, 2 anchored, 5 due by 24/12. Berth B - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 1 due by 16/1. Maintenance to shiploader no. 1. Five other vessels due by 23/12.
Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) - 4 Vessels due by 24/12.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading.
E.I. Island - 1 Vessel loading, 2 due.
Dampier lineup - 25 Vessels due.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 3 anchored, 10 due by 31/12.
Dec 18 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay - No vessels due. No shiploading on 25/12-26/12.
Gladstone - One wheat vessel due 20/12. No shiploading on 25/12 and 26/12.
Brisbane - Three vessels in port of which 1 loading wheat. 5 Vessels due by 28/12. No shiploading on 25/12-26/12.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Two wheat vessels due by 27/12. No shiploading on 25/12-26/12.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading cannola. 9 Vessels due. Loading operations will cease at 1200 hours 24/12. No loading on 25/12. Loading will recommence at 0715 hours 26/12.
VICTORIA - Geelong - One wheat vessel in port. 6 Vessels due by 15/1/97. No loading on 25/12-26/12.
Portland - Four wheat vessels due by 7/1/97. Vicgrain terminal advise no shiploading on 25/12. Shiploading on 26/12 will be subject to labour availability.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - One vessel loading wheat/barley. 1 Wheat vessel in port, 1 due on 25/12.
Port Adelaide - One wheat vessel in port. 3 Vessels due by 25/12.
Thevenard - One wheat vessel due on 19/12.
Port Lincoln - Eight vessels due by 4/1/97.
Wallaroo - One vessel loading wheat. 4 Vessels due by 25/12.
Ardrossan - One barley vessel due 20/12.

Port Giles - Seven vessels due by 4/1/97. Christmas working arrangements for all South Australian grain terminals advise work will cease at end of the day shift on 24/12. No shiploading on 25/12. Work to resume on commencent of day shift on 26/12.

WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - One barley vessel in port. 5 Vessels due by 3/1/97. Port closed on 20/12 due to picnic day. Work will cease at end of the day shift 24/12 (unless agreed). No work 25/12 (unless agreed). Ordinary working arrangements 26/12 from 0800 hours.
Kwinana - One wheat vessel in port. 14 Vessels due by 5/1/97. No shiploading from 1700 hours 24/12 to 0730 hours 27/12.
Albany - Five vessels due by 31/12. No shiploading from 1530 hours 24/12 until 26/12. Public holiday rates apply after 0730 hours 26/12 to 0730 hours 27/12.
Esperance - One vessel loading wheat/peas. 5 Vessels due by 2/1/97.
No shiploading from 1700 hours 24/12 to 0800 hours 26/12. Public holiday rates apply after 0800 hours 26/12 to 0800 hours 27/12.
